xfj2j5sf.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 55 cm Wide - Green - 210 cm
xfj2j5sf.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 55 cm Wide - Green - 210 cm
xfj2j5sf.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Christmas Tree redefines seasonal decor with its sleek, cone-shaped form and warm LED lights that evoke a sense of modern elegance. Combining practicality with style, this seasonal must-have is perfect for adding a touch of sophistication to any space, whether indoors or out, making it a versatile centerpiece for homes and offices alike. Durable Materials: Crafted from premium PVC, this tree presents a lifelike appearance while ensuring durability and long-lasting use. The metal framework provides stability, supporting the tree's structure perfectly and maintaining its shape through multiple festive seasons. This combination of materials makes it both robust and visually appealing. USB Electric Connectivity: This tree includes a USB plug connection that conveniently powers the LED strip lights, eliminating the need for traditional power outlets. The easy plug-and-play setup enhances usability, allowing for effortless installation and repositioning within any space throughout the holiday season. Warm White LED Lights: A timeless choice for Christmas decorations, the LED strip lights emit a soft, warm glow to create an inviting atmosphere. These energy-efficient lights are not only visually stunning but also ensure consistent illumination without overheating, making them safe for daily use and family-friendly gatherings. Indoor and Outdoor Placement: This artificial tree is suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings, offering versatility in decoration locations. Its adaptable design allows it to grace living rooms, terraces, and gardens, providing festive charm in various environments with minimal maintenance. Care &Storage Tips: For optimal maintenance, cover the tree when not in use and store it in a dry, cool place after the holiday. Regular care ensures its vibrant appearance and functionality over years, allowing you to enjoy festive moments time and again without the hassle of annual tree purchases. Product Specifications Colour: Green PVC and steel and plastic Tree height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 55 cm Durable With Thick Branches Lifelike Tips Number of PVC tips: 435 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

n9pv39kh.variantName: Christmas Tree World 40cm Blue Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball - Pack of 1
n9pv39kh.sourceDescription: Introducing the 40cm Inflatable Mirror Display Ball in Blue, a striking and versatile decorative solution designed to create instant impact in retail environments, commercial venues, events, exhibitions, and the home. Featuring a sleek mirror finish, this inflatable display ball reflects light and surroundings beautifully, making it ideal for eye-catching shop windows, visual merchandising, brand activations, and large-scale installations. A key advantage for commercial users is ease of storage. Once deflated or with the air removed using a compatible electric pump the display ball folds down to a fraction of its inflated size, making off-season storage simple and space-efficient. Manufactured from fire-retardant materials, the Inflatable Mirror Display Ball is suitable for use in commercial and public spaces. It is inflated once, sealed securely, and displayed without the need for a continuous power supply. Product Features • Size: 40cm (other sizes available) • Colour: Blue (other colours available) • Finish: High-gloss mirror effect • Material: Durable inflatable construction • Fire-resistant: Fire retardant material • Indoor & outdoor use • Installation options: Floor-standing, ceiling-hung, wall-mounted or secured to ground • Inflation: Inflated once and sealed no continuous air supply required • Storage: Fully deflates to take up minimal storage space • Pump: Electric air pump not included • Oversized gold bauble caps not included • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB

nd1nfbwh.variantName: Christmas Tree World 50cm Flocked Decorated Mixed Pine With Tartan Bows Wreath
nd1nfbwh.sourceDescription: Forget about spending time decorating your own Christmas wreath this year – we’ve attached a fantastic array of Xmas decorations to this unique festive centrepiece for you! Packed with pinecones, artificial red berries, Christmas baubles and charming tartan bows, it couldn’t be easier to fall in love with this 50cm flocked and decorated wreath from Christmas Tree World! Please note: Flocked Decorated Mixed Pine garland is not included. At 50cm, this festive wreath is the perfect size for hanging onto front doors and placing over mantelpieces. A sight to behold all in itself, this wreath really doesn’t need anything else to make it magical (although a few extra Christmas lights do offer an extra dose of fairy dust!) Accessories shown in the images are not included with the item. The product is sold without any accessories. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

we2rpe5j.variantName: Christmas Village Striped Faux Fur Christmas Tree Skirt 56cm - Green
we2rpe5j.sourceDescription: Give your Christmas tree a cosy finishing touch with the Christmas Village Vertical Striped Faux Fur Christmas Tree Skirt. Featuring a soft polyester faux fur outer and felt inner, this decorative round tree collar adds a textured finish while neatly concealing the base of your Christmas tree. The vertical striped design complements festive decorations, while the Velcro closure allows for easy fitting and removal. Lightweight and foldable for convenient storage between Christmas seasons. Product Dimensions: Height (H): 25cm, Width (W): 56cm, Depth (D): 56cm. Top Diameter: 40cm. Material: Polyester faux fur with felt inner, approximately 14mm thick. Product Weight: 0.27kg. Colour: Green. Includes 1 Christmas tree skirt. For decorative indoor use only. Keep away from naked flames, candles and direct heat sources. Do not place near exposed heating elements or damaged electrical connections. Keep packaging materials away from children. This product is not a toy. Ensure the tree skirt is positioned securely to avoid creating a trip hazard. HSI Global Ltd - 9 George Square Suite 320 Glasgow, G2 1QQ
